[[Baylor Bears basketball|Baylor]] (2011–2013) | draft_year = | draft_round = | draft_pick = | draft_team = | career_start = 2013 | career_end = | years1 = | team1 = | highlights = *[[National Invitation Tournament|NIT]] Most Outstanding Player (2013) *NIT champion (2013) *AP Honorable Mention All-American ([[2012 NCAA Men's Basketball All-Americans|2012]]) *2x Second team All-Big 12 (2012, 2013) *Big 12 All-Rookie team (2012) *NJCAA National Player of the Year (2011) *NJCAA first team All-American (2011) *NJCAA men's basketball tournament MVP (2011) | stat1label = | stat1value = | stat2label = | stat2value = | stat3label = | stat3value = | letter = | bbr = | HOF_player = | FIBA_HOF_player = }} '''Pierre Deshawn Jackson''' (born August 29, 1991) is an American college [[basketball]] player. He is a senior [[point guard]] for [[Baylor University]] and is considered one of the top returning college players for the [[2012–13 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2012–13 season]]. Jackson, attended [[Desert Pines High School]] in Las Vegas. Following a standout career, where he led the state of Nevada in assists as a senior, he went to the [[College of Southern Idaho]] (CSI). At CSI, Jackson led the Golden Eagles to a [[National Junior College Athletic Association]] (NJCAA) [[NJCAA Men's Division I Basketball Championship|National Championship]], earning tournament MVP honors. Jackson averaged 18.6 [[Points per game|points]] and 4.4 [[assists per game]] and was named a first-team All-American and the NJCAA Player of the Year at the conclusion of the season.{{cite web| last = | first = | title =CSI head coach and player earn national honors | publisher = CSI Athletics | date = April 15, 2011 | url =http://athletics.csi.edu/news/2011/4/15/MBB_0415114228.aspx?path=mbball | accessdate = November 16, 2012}} After concluding his junior college career, Jackson moved to [[Baylor Bears basketball|Baylor]] to complete his college career. He had a strong junior campaign for the Bears, averaging 13.8 points and 5.9 assists in the [[2011–12 Baylor Bears basketball team|2011–12 season]]. He helped lead Baylor to the Elite Eight of the [[2012 NCAA Men's Division I Basketball Tournament|2012 NCAA Tournament]], where they lost to eventual champions [[2011–12 Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball team|Kentucky]]. Jackson was named second team All-[[Big 12 Conference]] and an honorable mention [[NCAA Men's Basketball All-Americans|All-American]] by the [[Associated Press]].{{cite web| last = | first = | title =All-America Honors Continue For Big 12 Men's Basketball | publisher = [[Big 12 Conference]] | date = March 26, 2012 | url =http://www.big12sports.com/ViewArticle.dbml?SPSID=106110&SPID=13134&DB_LANG=C&DB_OEM_ID=10410&ATCLID=205404258 | accessdate = November 16, 2012}} Jackson returned to Baylor for his senior season in [[2012–13 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2012–13]]. He was named the Big 12 preseason Player of the Year{{cite web| last = | first = | title =Jackson Leads Preseason All-Big 12 Squad | publisher = [[Big 12 Conference]] | date = October 4, 2012 | url =http://www.big12sports.com/ViewArticle.dbml?SPSID=106110&SPID=13134&DB_LANG=C&DB_OEM_ID=10410&ATCLID=205697199 | accessdate = November 16, 2012}} and was named to the preseason watch lists for the [[Wooden Award|Wooden]]{{cite web| last = Borzello | first = Jeff | title =JOHN R. WOODEN AWARD ANNOUNCES MEN’S PRESEASON TOP 50 | publisher = [[Wooden Award]] | date = November 8, 2012 | url =http://www.woodenaward.com/?p=1275 | accessdate = November 16, 2012}} and [[Naismith Award|Naismith]]{{cite web| last = Borzello | first = Jeff | title =Naismith announces early-season watch list | publisher = CBSSports.com | date = November 13, 2012 | url =http://www.cbssports.com/collegebasketball/blog/eye-on-college-basketball/20967590/naismith-announces-early-season-watch-list | accessdate = November 16, 2012}} national player of the year awards.
